name: Event Monster – Event Management, Calendar & Booking for WordPress
author: A WP Life

sections.description:
Event Monster is the most powerful and user-friendly event management plugin for WordPress. Create stunning events, display interactive calendars, manage registrations, and engage your attendees – all with a beautiful modern interface.

Whether you’re organizing conferences, workshops, webinars, concerts, or community meetups, Event Monster provides everything you need to create and manage successful events on your WordPress website.

🚀 Version 2.0.0 – Complete Redesign!

This major update brings a completely redesigned interface with modern UI, improved performance, and exciting new features. Your existing events and data are fully preserved.

✨ Key Features

📅 Interactive Event Calendar
Display your events in a beautiful, fully-responsive calendar. Choose from Month, Week, Day, or List views. Uses FullCalendar 6.1.10 for smooth interactions.

📋 Modern Event List
Showcase your events with stunning card-based layouts. Features search, filtering, and category organization.

🎫 Event Registration & Booking
Accept free registrations directly on your website. Collect attendee information with customizable registration forms.

👥 Attendee Management
Track and manage your event visitors. View registration details, send emails, and export attendee lists.

🗓️ Countdown Timer
Build excitement with beautiful countdown timers on your event pages.

🗺️ Location Maps
Display event locations with interactive OpenStreetMap integration – no API key required!

👨‍💼 Organizer Profiles
Showcase event organizers with dedicated profile sections including contact information and social links.

📧 Email Notifications
Automatic email confirmations for registrations. Keep attendees informed about their bookings.

📱 Fully Responsive
All templates and calendars are fully responsive and look great on any device.

🎨 Modern Admin Interface
Enjoy a clean, intuitive admin experience built with modern design principles.

📌 Shortcodes

  • [EM id="X"] – Display a single event
  • [EM-LIST] – Display your event list with beautiful card layout
  • [EM-CALENDAR] – Display interactive event calendar
  • [EM] – Legacy shortcode support (displays event list)

🔒 Starter Version Includes

  • Unlimited events
  • Interactive calendar with all views
  • Event registration forms
  • Attendee management
  • Email notifications
  • OpenStreetMap integration
  • Countdown timers
  • Social sharing
  • Gallery images (up to 5 per event)
  • Speakers (up to 3 per event)
  • Sponsors (up to 3 per event)
  • Schedule items (up to 5 per event)
  • Preset layouts (Default & Magazine)

⭐ Upgrade to Event Monster Pro

Unlock the full potential with Event Monster Pro:

  • ✅ Unlimited Everything – No limits on galleries, speakers, sponsors, schedules
  • ✅ Payment Gateways – Accept payments via PayPal, Stripe, Razorpay, Square
  • ✅ Ticket Management – Create and sell multiple ticket types
  • ✅ Coupon System – Offer discounts with promo codes
  • ✅ Custom Layout Builder – Drag-and-drop event page customization
  • ✅ Advanced Email Templates – Professional, customizable email designs
  • ✅ SMTP Integration – Reliable email delivery
  • ✅ Priority Support – Fast, dedicated assistance

sections.installation:
Automatic Installation (Recommended)

  1. Go to Plugins > Add New in your WordPress admin
  2. Search for “Event Monster”
  3. Click “Install Now” and then “Activate”
  4. Navigate to Event Monster in your admin menu to create your first event

Manual Installation

  1. Download the plugin ZIP file
  2. Go to Plugins > Add New > Upload Plugin
  3. Choose the ZIP file and click “Install Now”
  4. Activate the plugin
  5. Start creating events!

After Installation

  1. Go to Event Monster > Add New Event to create your first event
  2. Use [EM-CALENDAR] shortcode to display the calendar on any page
  3. Use [EM-LIST] shortcode to show your event list
sections.faq:
How do I display the event calendar?

Use the shortcode [EM-CALENDAR] on any page or post to display an interactive event calendar.

How do I show an event list?

Use the shortcode [EM-LIST] to display all your events in a beautiful card layout with filtering options.

How do I display a single event?

Use the shortcode [EM id="X"] where X is your event ID. You can find the ID in the Events list.

Can I accept payments for events?

The free version supports free event registrations. For paid tickets and payment gateway integration (PayPal, Stripe, Razorpay, Square), please upgrade to Event Monster Pro.

How many events can I create?

Unlimited events in both the free Starter and Pro versions!

Do I need a Google Maps API key?

No! Event Monster uses OpenStreetMap for location maps, which is completely free and requires no API key.

Is the plugin compatible with my theme?

Yes! Event Monster is designed to work with any properly coded WordPress theme. The modern CSS is scoped to prevent conflicts.

Will my old shortcodes still work after updating?

Yes! All existing shortcodes including [EM id="X"] continue to work. The old [EM] shortcode now displays the event list automatically.

Is my data safe when updating to version 2.0.0?

Absolutely! All your existing events, settings, and attendee data are fully preserved during the update.
